Majada.description: A Zen-inspired retreat located just minutes from Galala City, focusing on wellness, art, and relaxation.

Carnellia.amenities: Elevators to beach, infinity pools, boutique hotel, private beach
Carnellia.description: A neighbor to Il Monte Galala, offering high-elevation luxury with seamless beach access and modern designs.

Baymount.amenities: Mountain elevator, amphitheater, commercial hub, infinity pools
Baymount.description: Offers spectacular mountain and sea views with a unique architectural design and direct beach access.

The Groove.amenities: 350,000 sqm, marina, clubhouse, retail area, squash courts
The Groove.description: A lively resort located on the Galala road, designed for year-round entertainment and convenience.

Il Monte Galala.paymentPlan: 10% Down Payment, over 12 Years (or 30% Cash Discount)
Il Monte Galala.amenities: 1.4km coastline, mountain-top lagoons, rock climbing, hotels, commercial hub
Il Monte Galala.description: A 'Coastal Universe on the rocks' spanning 2.24 million sqm, offering unique mountain and sea views with world-class facilities.

Stella Di Mare 1.description: One of Ain Sokhna's most established resorts, located on km 46 of the Suez-Hurghada road. It features a massive 40,000m2 private beach and lush tropical landscaping.
Stella Di Mare 1.amenities: Stella Grand Hotel, Diving Center, Mini Golf, Shopping Mall

Stella Di Mare 2.description: An extension of the Stella brand, focusing on family-friendly holidays with island-like clusters surrounded by artificial lakes and gardens.
Stella Di Mare 2.amenities: Artificial Lakes, Sea View Hotel, Commercial area, Health Club

Azha.description: A massive 1.6 million sqm high-end waterfront resort in Sokhna. Known for its 'Tanoak' hotel and extensive swimmable crystal lagoons.
Azha.amenities: Tanoak Hotel, Downtown Azha (Retail & Dining), Entry Park, Crystal Lagoons (swimmable)

Marina Wadi Degla.description: A key destination in Sokhna known for its private marina and vibrant nightlife. It offers a mix of chalets and villas with direct access to marina services.
Marina Wadi Degla.amenities: Private Marina, Yacht Club, Nightlife venues, Promenade

Jaz Little Venice.description: A 5-star golf resort bringing the Italian spirit to Sokhna. It features a 9-hole championship golf course and sophisticated room designs.
Jaz Little Venice.amenities: 9-hole Golf Course, Sanctuary Spa, Gourmet Dining, Heated Swimming Pools

Ain Bay.description: A prestigious golf resort known for its calm atmosphere and the famous Ein Bay Golf Course. It serves as a prime destination for golfers and families.
Ain Bay.amenities: 18-hole Golf Course, Clubhouse, Social Hub, Private Beach

Aroma.description: Located at Km 34 Sokhna-Suez road, Aroma offers a fully serviced lifestyle with modern architecture and a partnership with specialized hotel management.
Aroma.amenities: Aroma Beach Club, Serviced Residences, Water Sports Center, Kids Area

Blumar El Sokhna.description: A family-centric resort featuring a 350m private beach and vast green landscapes. Known for its 'Bus Stop' commercial hub nearby.
Blumar El Sokhna.amenities: Theme Park, Retail Area, Multiple Swimming Pools, Sports Courts

La Serena Mini Egypt.description: A unique concept resort featuring miniature replicas of Egypt's famous landmarks (Pyramids, Sphinx, Cairo Tower) along the Nile-style lazy river.
La Serena Mini Egypt.amenities: Miniature Monuments, Lazy River (The Nile), Aqua Park, Open-air theater
